response.rationale: A and B overlap but don't name the same capability. B is a narrower part of A. A, "Ticket sales, online payment and refunds", covers two classes: BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180) for ticket sales and bookings, and PuckPayClient (node 8ce0b3f14177346a) for payment. B, "Online payment and refunds", covers only PuckPayClient. The two share the payment and refund part through PuckPayClient. A adds ticket sales and booking, which B leaves out. Since B fits inside A and doesn't cover all of it, they are not the same capability.
